summary: muk Haircare is a Melbourne-based, Australian-owned professional haircare brand in 15+ countries. In 2026 it appointed a new CEO (Damian McCarthy, July), a new CFO (Laura Buckley, March) and a Finance Manager (Sasha Raicevic, May), and describes its biggest growth phase yet under a three-year strategy.
